title: Federal controlled-substance schedules
rule_summary: Federal controlled-substance classifications are established in 21 CFR Part 1308; drug-specific questions must cite the exact applicable schedule section rather than an undifferentiated omnibus reference.
exam_relevance: Classification determines which issue, refill, transfer, partial-fill, record, and reporting rules must be evaluated under federal and Massachusetts law.
exceptions: Massachusetts Schedule VI includes prescription drugs not placed in another Massachusetts schedule and can add state-specific consequences without changing federal status.
common_confusions: MassPAT reportability does not alter a drug's federal schedule.
Clinical class names such as opioid or stimulant do not by themselves determine schedule.
verification_notes: Federal and Massachusetts schedule frameworks checked on 2026-08-13; drug records carry exact drug-specific sections.
